No. 16; Page No. 63 (a) From my reading of the passage, I can mention that the denial of freedom to a nation by foreign rulers is one of the reasons of armed conflict between two countries. (b) The people who fought in the war of Independence and freed us from the occupation forces are called freedom fighter. (c) Our war of independance against Pakistani occupation forces was a glorious one. In this great war the Bengali members of the armed forces, the students and the people from all walks of life took part. After nine months of bloody war, our freedom fighters made the Pakistan army surrender to us. (d) We are indebted to freedom fighters because they fought a glorious war of independence against the Pakistani occupation forces in 1971, for a long nine months and defeated the well-trained Pakistani forces. Many of them sacrificed their lives for motherland. So, we are indebted to freedom fighters. (e) Yes. I support the idea because the people of this country had undergone extreme exploitation and sufferings under the rulers of foreigners for a long time and these freedom fighters have freed this nation. So, I think the people of this soil will cherish the memory of the valiant sons forever.
